# McKinney R & R LLC

> Roofing, remodeling & repairs based in Cibolo, Texas. Veteran-owned McKinney R & R replaces roofs, remodels bathrooms, coats garage floors and handles insurance repairs. Reviewers say Branden is on site, on time and easy to talk to.

- Phone: (830) 499-7663
- Based in: Cibolo, TX
- Service area: Cibolo, Schertz, Converse, Universal City, Selma, New Braunfels, Garden Ridge
- Google rating: 5.0 from 52 reviews
- Request a quote: https://vinaynay9.github.io/smb_fde/hs/mckinney-r-and-r/quote.html
- Book a visit: https://vinaynay9.github.io/smb_fde/hs/mckinney-r-and-r/book.html

## Services
- Roof replacement: Tear-off and new architectural shingle roofs, one of the jobs reviewers mention most.
- Bathroom remodels: Guest and hall baths rebuilt down to the subfloor when needed, finished in tile.
- Kitchens, flooring & drywall: Kitchen updates, new plank flooring and drywall patched, textured, painted and trimmed.
- Garage floor coatings: Epoxy flake floors that turn a dusty garage slab into a clean, finished space.
- Decks, patios & fences: Deck replacements, patio extensions, shed pads and wood privacy fences.
- Repairs, big and small: Fascia, gutters, ceiling fans, awnings, walkways and water or storm damage.

## About
McKinney R & R LLC is a veteran-owned general contractor at 317 Country Vale in Cibolo, run by Branden McKinney. Branden works on the jobs alongside his crew, and customers mention him by name in review after review. The work runs from full roof replacements, deck rebuilds and guest-bath remodels to fascia, gutters, ceiling fans, a 20-foot retractable awning and a crumbling tree ring. Estimates can start online or on site, and one customer’s estimate for a collapsed garage entry wall was approved by insurance right away.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you work with insurance claims?
  A: Yes. One customer’s estimate to rebuild a collapsed garage entry wall was approved by their insurance right away, and the work finished on the committed date.
- Q: Will you take a small job?
  A: Yes. Reviewers have hired McKinney R & R for a tree ring repair, fascia, ceiling fans and a single awning.
- Q: Can I get an estimate online?
  A: Yes. Send photos through the quote form or call, and Branden can follow up on site.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Friday 7 AM to 5 PM and Saturday 7 AM to 2 PM. Closed Sunday.
- Q: Where are you based?
  A: 317 Country Vale in Cibolo, serving Schertz, Converse, Universal City, Selma, New Braunfels and Garden Ridge.
